ABOUT THIS PREVIEW

A world in the making.

This is an interactive website prototype, using RAO’s improved artwork. The PvP loop is a product-design direction, not a statement that every feature is live.

Rankings use illustrative characters, and a game download has not been connected. The essence walk is a small website interaction, separate from the game’s economy.

Artwork reference: the approved-art package from client PR237. Public ranking rules, final downloads and additional mounts remain to be connected.
